notes.content: [p]Hey Citizens,[/p][p]we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.13 with the following changes:[/p][p][/p][h3]Civics:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Added:[/b] The new game value "House Value at Deed" intended for usage in rent calculations, allowing to select either the deed the recurring rent transfer is related to or a manually selected deed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] The option to round values in laws didn't work correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that allowed to bypass the maximum carry weight for the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed: [/b]Expired loan contracts didn't complete when they were paid off if the server was restarted between expiration and paying off.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] The displayed influence range of draft settlements in shadow placement mode didn't equal the actual influence range in which placement is possible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] The displayed time until meteor impact could differ between the display below the meteor and the /met command showing the remaining time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] A room system related crash that could appear when using specific mods.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Server & Configs[/h3][p][b][u]Civics.template.eco[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Added:[/b] "AllowLawsToPreventReputationTransfer" config variable, determining if laws can block the transfer of reputation - defaults to false.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.12 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.12 with the following changes:

[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A server crash that could happen when a secession election ended successfully.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A citizen of a higher-tier settlement that placed the foundation of a lower-tier settlement would lose the citizenship of the newly placed draft settlement when moving their homestead, also losing the draft Mayor title - this led to the settlement becoming unconfigurable. Instead, the player can now keep the citizenship of the draft settlement as long as the homestead was moved within its theoretical influence.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Authorized users on a table could change the repair bounty settings, allowing them to set the price the owner pays for a repair bounty and fulfill it for that price.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An exploit that allowed to retain an outdoor room despite industrial objects being present by placing the outdoor objects on top of the industrial objects.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Authorized citizens were unable to consume items stored inside a storage object.[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The crafting UI didn't display set crafting fees to the player.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Item tooltips didn't display the names of stores buying or selling the item.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The reputation tooltip did no longer display its contents when a reputation message exceeding 80 characters was present.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Server achievements didn't persist through server restarts anymore.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Marketplace purchases could fail on servers with specific currency denominators.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Introduced simple culling for lights, improving FPS in crowded towns.[/list]
[h3]Server & Configs[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] Rebalanced defaults for "WeightCultureByPercentOfNeighboringPlotsChildSettlement" and "WeightCultureByPercentOfNeighboringPlotsSiblingSettlement" in Settlements.eco to make annexation of properties at borders much harder. Administrators that want to apply these changes need to update their Settlements.eco file.[/list]
[u][b]WorldGenerator.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "MaxGenerationHeight" config variable, determining the maximum height terrain will have after world generation - defaults to 120.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] "MaxBuildHeight" config variable, determining up to which height players can place blocks. Changes take effect even after world generation, but this variable cannot be reduced below a value once it has been set. The value underlies limits depending on the world size and must be set with care - defaults to 160.
[*] [b]Removed:[/b] "WorldHeight" config variable, as it has been split into the above.[/list]

notes.title: Eco 12 Preview
notes.content:
Hello Eco Citizens!

The journey towards Eco 1.0 continues, and the team is incredibly excited about the progress we're making. We know you're all eager to hear what's cooking, so we wanted to share a few key features and improvements we've been working on recently.

[h2]Free Placement
[/h2]
For a long time, we (and many of you!) have felt the constraints of the rigid placement grid. Remember trying to make a room feel just right, only to be forced into unnatural alignment against a wall? We're thrilled to announce the upcoming ability to place most objects freely, independent of the world grid. This opens up enormous possibilities for interior design, workshop organization, and general world decoration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/1bf3b8ea6b157044f839e8fa3a20c8fed9c31115.jpg[/img]
We're finally enabling placement on top of other surfaces, like tables. Imagine setting a table with tools, decorative items, or even food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/af31c6092e621ae1e898aba897e913970f828b15.jpg[/img]
You'll also gain significantly more control over object rotation, allowing for truly nuanced and personalized arrangements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/a28126ff1fff6bdfab5081b365e66eb32e9e7aab.jpg[/img]
We've already been blown away by the incredible scenes players have crafted even with the old limitations. We genuinely cannot wait to see the astounding creativity you'll unleash with this newfound freedom!

[h2]Selling Directly From Surfaces
[/h2]Now that you can place objects directly on surfaces, you can also mark these placed objects for sale. You’ll be able to visually stock a store and have customers interact and purchase directly from the objects themselves. It’ll even automatically display pricetags on placed items that are marked for sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/dcd856e74daed6a0a1006e309b4f05e6e02d5343.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dinner Parties
[/h2]Placing food on tables also allows a new gameplay feature, Dinner Parties! Yes, you'll soon be able to lay out a proper feast. This isn't just about aesthetics; it's about fostering community and culture. Host elaborate dinner parties for your neighbours, share a simple meal with a friend, or organize grand diplomatic banquets for citizens across the globe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/a12d2a78dc6034ccee35a28e2dcdaa82a9710e7e.png[/img]

While we'll dive into the specifics in a dedicated future post, we can tease that these gatherings are more than just role-playing opportunities. Sharing food and participating in these social events will carry tangible [b]cultural significance[/b] within the game, with multipliers when you bring together people from neighboring settlements, adding another layer to Eco's societal simulation. Stay tuned for more details!

[h2]Animal Husbandry[/h2]
We've also embarked on the development of a long-requested feature: Animal Husbandry! Here's a sneak peek at some of the new assets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/99479e2e54eb3f5c0fda9f50bc554fcc6657eb88.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/306db7523c0489bcec52d3728de435c91c989926.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/e6800df39e1214b516a830ccd8758a1da5183910.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/3422860c5d1ce95912e3be8897ddcf2f0023e452.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/bc90673897e9720b4f995d738d2c799b213f4f22.png[/img]
This is just the beginning of bringing domesticated animals to Eco, offering new pathways for sustainable food production and resource management.  This will be in a later update, after the others mentioned above.

[h2]Looking Ahead
[/h2]These are just a few highlights of what we've been working on as we push towards Eco 1.0. Our goal is to make the world of Eco richer, more interactive, and provide you, the players, with even more tools to build, collaborate, and shape your environment and society.

We're incredibly grateful for your continued support and passion for Eco. Keep an eye out for more updates, and as always, happy building!

Best, The Strange Loop Games Team

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.11 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.11 with the following changes:

[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] The unpreventable trigger "Settlement Founded", allowing to create laws that act on the founding of a settlement.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] Tree Debris is now available as a selectable block for the "Drop or Pickup Block" trigger, before it was only selectable by choosing "Any".
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Assigning two titles as the holder of the respective other one created a loop that led to a server crash, it is no longer possible to do that.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] Modules can no longer be removed from a crafting table when there are queued crafting projects.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] The tooltip of pump jacks no longer shows the value of the oil layer at the players current position when the oil layer is configured to be hidden until the respective specialty was discovered.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Consolidating a storage that contained multiple identical steam tractor modules would link the durability between them.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Power generators did not consume part durability.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Skill Books and Skill Scrolls stored in a vehicle that was transferred to a different owner could still be used by the prior owner without having authorization to do so.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] The icon of the player on the map now stays smaller when zooming.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Players could get stuck when connecting to a server indefinitely if their username triggered the profanity filter of that server. The game will now correctly present an error message in that case and cancel the connection attempt.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could lead to platform invites (Discord, Steam) not working, showing a "Disconnected" error instead of establishing the connection. Note that establishing connection via invites can take a bit longer than direct joining, please allow it some time.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The client could be disconnected from the server with an exception when mounting a vehicle while construction placement is active.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The chat allowed the usage of some HTML tags that were not intended to be usable, leading to display and performance issues with the chat for everyone on the server. Only the tags listed on the text markup section of the [url=https://wiki.play.eco/en/Chat_Commands]wiki[/url] are now usable in the chat. (Known issue: If you paste invalid HTML code into the chat, you will no longer be able to see what you type in chat until reconnecting, this will be fixed in a separate update)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Multiple display issues like overlapping UI elements when using aspect ratios other than 16:9.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Twitch drops that provide blueprints no longer cause an empty box to appear in the void storage that cannot be removed and led to the void storage icon being permanently present. This fix is not retroactive and only applies once a new world is joined.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Copying the ID from a tooltip tended to copy a number that wasn't equal to the ID shown in the tooltip.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In places a number of Eco credits is displayed, the unit separators were not functioning correctly.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Some small optimizations improving FPS for players on larger servers.[/list]
[h3]Voice Chat:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Some issues that prevented establishing a connection to the voice chat servers. 
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] After a voice chat got cut off due to leaving the audible distance, it was possible that the connection to the voice chat servers was lost and voice chat hence not being possible until a game restart.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] After clicking the icon to mute a player it was not possible to click it again without reopening the UI.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Spatial audio wasn't working correctly.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The Voice Input Device dropdown could show incorrect devices.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Input and Output volumes were wrongly set after the last Vivox update, they will reset to the default values with this Eco update.[/list]
[h3]Server & Configs[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] The server settings for the voice chat that priorly had no effect are now functional and listed as "Added" below.[/list]
[u][b]Balance.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] "FuelMultiplier" config variable, determining the [i]fuel yield per unit[/i], now correctly increases effective [i]fuel consumption[/i] for values below 1 and decreases it for values above 1 as its description notes.[/list]
[u][b]Civics.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] "RecurringTransferFrequencyInMinutes" config variable, determining the frequency of reccuring transfers, now defaults to 60 to be in line with the information shown in in-game UI's.[/list]
[u][b]Voice.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "AudibleDistance" config variable, determining the maximum distance away from a speaker that a listener can hear the speaker. - defaults to 32.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] "ConversationalDistance" config variable, determining the range within which a speaker’s audio remains at its original volume, and beyond which the loudness of the voice chat starts to fade out when heard - defaults to 3.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] "AudioFadeModel" config variable, determining the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the Conversational Distance and the Audible Distance - accepts InverseByDistance (Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance), LinearByDistance (Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance) and ExponentialByDistance (Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it) and defaults to ExponentialByDistance.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] "AudioFadeIntensityByDistance" config variable, determining the amplitude of the curve to make the attenuation of the voice chat loudness more or less extreme - defaults 1.
[*] Developers Note:
[quote]When customizing distance values, consider the following guidelines:

ConversationalDistance is the distance from the listener at which a speaker’s voice is heard at its original volume. This must be an integer in the range 0 <= ConversationalDistance <= AudibleDistance. Consider this to be the expected close-by conversational distance. The ConversationalDistance sounds the most realistic when it's half the height of a typical speaking entity in your game.

When using the default AudioFadeModel value, if you want voice chat to naturally fade to near zero loudness at the edge of the AudibleDistance so it doesn't sound like it's being abruptly cut off, then set the AudibleDistance to a minimum of: 32 × ConversationalDistance ÷ AudioFadeIntensityByDistance.

When using the ExponentialByDistance AudioFadeModel, it's recommended that you keep the ConversationalDistance value at 1 or greater and adjust the value of the AudioFadeIntensityByDistance property based on the following formula: AudioFadeIntensityByDistance = 3 ÷ (1 + 1.75 × log10(ConversationalDistance))[/quote][/list]

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.10 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.10 with the following changes:

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] Elevators now lose ten times less durability than before when used.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] Industrial Mill is now crafted at the Electric Machinist table.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] Cyan Powder recipe now requires Milling and is made on an Industrial Mill.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] Processed Flour recipe now creates Cereal Germ as a byproduct.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Industrial Mill did not consume fuel as intended.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was possible to place objects underwater that weren't intended to be placed there.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A templating issue when a item had both a parent and multiple crafting stations in the techtree, relevant for modders.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A spelling error in VehicleScoopHandlerComponent, relevant for modders - make sure to update any override files for vehicles.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue with items that require a blueprint and are crafted on multiple crafting tables, relevant for modders - make sure to update any override files for recipes.[/list]
In celebration of this year's season of the "Un monde incroyaux" roleplay server, this update also adds the Banana Rug and the Banana Shirt to the marketplace, one free blueprint of both again being available as a Twitch drop from February 28 to March 28. For more details, check out our [url=https://play.eco/twitch]twitch drop page[/url].

[h3]UI:[/h3]

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.8 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.8 with the following changes:

[h3]Graphics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The driving animation for the canoe didn't work correctly when there was two players in it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Paddle movements when driving a canoe were not correctly synchronized with the view of other players.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Standing on dynamite during the explosion could lead to the VFX and SFX effects not playing.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Some objects, like dynamite, wrongly cast a shadow for their bounding box.[/list]
[h3]Interaction:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was no longer possible to hold the e key to pick up mining rubble.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Pressing the enter key multiple times in quick succession to confirm a transaction could lead to the client being disconnected from the server with a "Failed to process a request" error.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Deleting a store category could sometimes lead to nearby store categories being deleted as well.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Some vehicles could get picked up when trying to take out the last stored item when the player has left the vehicle just a short moment ago.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Repairable items could still be stacked to average their durability when using shift drag.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An explosion affecting a trash bag on the ground led to the corruption of the trash bag inventory, making it impossible to remove the trash bag.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Currency exchange listings that were created after another player had viewed the exchange listings once didn't function correctly.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The wanted list in the store only checked if any of the set requirements is true to allow the player to sell the item, which could lead to the player being presented with an error when trying to do so as for example the durability requirement was fulfilled but not the one for integrity. It now checks that all requirements are met before allowing the player to sell the item.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The minimum and maximum durability and integrity weren't shown in the wanted list of the store. 
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Items consumed to repair another item in the tool bench weren't removed from the slot until the table was closed and reopened.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Using a pickaxe could lead to mining effects being shown for nearby players also holding a pickaxe, despite not using it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The tooltip for currency exchanges displayed exchange rates in reverse.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The tooltip for the culture value of a settlement deed could wrongly note that the deed is not placed in a settlement, despite that not being possible.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] All executive actions will now show a confirmation, also showing when the executive action failed due to missing jurisdiction.[/list]
[h3]Server:[/h3]
[b][u]Difficulty.template.eco[/u][/b]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] "FuelMultiplier" config variable was renamed to "FuelEfficiencyMultiplier" and now increases the runtime fuel yields when the value is increased and the other way round.[/list]
Additionally, this update enables marketplace credit shares for settlements: All active citizens of a settlement will now receive a credit share if a fellow citizen purchases a marketplace item.

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.7 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.7 with the following changes:

[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When an election to fill multiple slots of the same office would end with a player having the most votes and some players with less votes being tied between each other, the player having the most votes did not receive the office.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Executive orders trying to seize a vehicle were failing without showing a reason, seizing a vehicle is now possible when the owner is a citizen of the settlement.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The jurisdiction for the law triggers "Create Work Order" and "Add Labour to Work Order" was not correctly limited to crafting tables located within settlement influence, but also affected all citizens of the settlement no matter where the crafting table was located.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was possible to transfer money to the treasury of a settlement that hasn't been founded yet, leading to the money being stuck there until the settlement is founded.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Removing a claim stake whose attached deed contributes to culture led to a server crash.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In work parties it was possible to grant access to titles the player wasn't a manager of, allowing players to gain membership of any title.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Civic objects that were disabled due to no longer being within influence of a settlement didn't update their status when only being moved back to the influence instead of being picked up and replaced there.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When repairable parts were supposed to be replaced through a repair bounty they instead averaged their durability.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In the store, durability configurations applied to integrity, e.g. a tool with reduced integrity but full durability wasn't listed if its integrity was below the configured durability value.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Adding light sources to outdoor rooms wouldn't provide housing points until the deed was updated by resizing the deed, changing a building block or adding a different furniture item.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was possible to buy objects that had active work orders on them.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was possible to buy the foundation of a unfounded settlement with ratified constitution, leading to the proceeds of the sale being transferred to the unfounded settlement's treasury which due to the ownership change of the settlement foundation will be destroyed during the purchasing process, the money hence being removed from the world.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Trying to join a server through a Discord or Steam invite could fail with an error claiming that the requested server was not found.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Removing a crafting table with active craft orders for marketplace items with the devtool didn't refund the used blueprints.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A tree would only count to no longer be present on the world for statistic purposes when all its logs and the stump were removed - it is now considered to be no longer present when it was felled.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Vehicles were getting picked up when trying to take out the last stored item when holding the hammer.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A player causing an animation effect by using a tool on an object could lead to the same animation effect being played at a different user holding the same tool and looking at a similar object in the vincinity despite they were not using their tool.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Country foundations were not correctly uncovering themselves after founding.
[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] Readability of the bank account history. (Thanks to @Thibault-Brocheton)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When moving a minimized category in the store UI around, all categories would expand again.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When trying to list a picture in a store (which is not possible), a blank listing appeared.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When a settlement issued an injunction against a law of a child settlement, all child settlements were separately notified about the injunction even when they weren't affected by it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The sidebar notifcation about a settlement being disabled due to its foundation having been disabled for too long wasn't formatted correctly.[/list]
[h3]Server:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A potential cause for a server crash when restarting a server while overloaded.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The configured ending date for holidays was not recognized correctly.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The QA command /unclaimabandoned sometimes used by admins only removed deeds, but not the respective claim stakes, potentially leading to savegame corruption.[/list]
[b][u]Settlements.template.eco[/u][/b]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "BasePlotsOnOutpostClaimStake" config variable, determining the amount of claims an outpost claimstake inherently comes with - defaults to 16.[/list]
Additionally, to celebrate the launch of the new viking-themed Dimworld Eco RP roleplay season, we have created the Norse steel axe perfectly suited for all the vikings out there. It is now available in the Eco Marketplace and for limited time until February 3 one blueprint of it is also available as a free [url=https://play.eco/twitch]Twitch Drop[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix 11.1.6 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Hotfix 11.1.6 to address the following issues:

[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Worlds with a distribution station that contained specific items couldn't be loaded anymore after they were shut down.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Dynamite could be picked up after it was ignited, leading to the dynamite being preserved and the explosion still happening.[/list]

With the year nearing its end, we'd like to thank you for your support this year and wish you happy holidays - stay tuned for what's coming to Eco next year and have a great time!

notes.title: Hotfix 11.1.5 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Hotfix 11.1.5 to address the following issues:

[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Claim papers and stakes would convert to their generic versions instead of being removed when the player that led to their creation left the settlement.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When trying to create a bank account after having reached the limit of 20 bank accounts the player was disconnected from the server with an error message.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] It was unintentionally possible to list pictures for sale in stores.[/list]
[h3]Interaction:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Claims wouldn't be highlighted with supported items & tools when switching to them from a hammer.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When placing specific items, their shadow placement wouldn't disappear despite the item no longer being held.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Occupancy of the Small Shipyard was wrong, leading to placement potentially being blocked due to vehicles that weren't near the object.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Some tools like the remote detonator couldn't be used while in fly mode.[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Some hair and hat combinations led to avatars being invisible and not editable.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A rare server crash related to water filters that could happen under specific circumstances.

notes.title: Maintenance Update 11.1.3 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 11.1.3 with the following changes:

[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Using a federation claim stake within a child settlement and setting the deed to cultural would wrongly prompt a warning about the deed not being attached to the settlement foundation.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Contracts containing specific types of clauses could be edited by unauthorized citizens.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The law trigger "Place or Pick Up Object" would trigger the set effects multiple times instead of once.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Rents using dynamic value for their calculation didn't function and always charged 0.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The law action "Ignore Auth" wasn't working when the target to ignore auth for was wood pulp.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The law trigger "Receive Government Funds" watched for users of an account instead of its managers.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Contracts requiring tools to be put somewhere or be transported didn't function.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When deleting a draft settlement, the treasury would not be deleted or moved to the parent settlement but become orphaned instead, visible to everyone with a treasury access.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When a law that contains "Ignore Auth" was present, players could also take out claims from the foundation, no matter if the law covered that case or not.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Leaving citizenship of a town in draft led to an RPC error.
[/list]
[h3]Interaction:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] All benches and couches can now be used by multiple players. 
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Moving a picture or painting to a different inventory slot would turn it into a generic, unusable item.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The consolidate button would merge claim papers and stakes from different settlements together.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Annexation didn't consider items stored in vehicles and presented an error when the required amount of items wasn't present in a storage object.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Automatic storage linking didn't work when the deed owner is a title.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] After every interaction with a vehicle, for a short moment the text "%WornParts%" flickered up.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Objects with broken parts would have their parts repaired after being sold in a store.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Crafting projects consumed part durability in worktables even when paused.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When the tutorial was already completed on a server and a new server was joined, the tutorial did start again but could not be completed.[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] Vines will now spread more consistent.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When reconnecting one's avatar could sometimes display the inside of the face and show (partly) invisible for other players or show other oddities.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The "Game Speed" world setting option "Very Fast" set the "SkillCostMultiplier" to 2.5 instead of 0.25 and the option "Very Slow" set it to 1.25 instead of 2. This was wrong and lead to a extremely slower skill gain in the first case and a much faster skill gain the second. If you use either, please press ESC -> World Settings when playing on your world and change the setting to different one and back again to apply the correct values.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Sitting on an object where another player also sits and then standing up again would disable the exhaustion timer until reconnection to the server.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Marketplace items could be built without being limited by blueprint amount in offline mode.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The capitol object only available when settlements are disabled wouldn't uncover after ratification of the constitution.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that can lead window shutters to be moved into the block they are supposed to cover.[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] The "Annexation Details" in the popup showing after an annexation now sums up multiple payments of the same items to display them only once.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Clicking on the icon of an recipe did not select it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The amount of users having a specific specialty would sometimes not display in the skills menu.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The notification appearing when one of the player's properties has a higher housing value than the current residence didn't correctly display the "Change Residency" button.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The message appearing when an election cannot be started due to invalid elements in the civic to be passed wrongly showed the invalid elements twice.[/list]
[h3]Server:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] The server now uses .NET Core 8, [u][b]most .dll mods will need to be recompiled[/b][/u].
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] The linux installation script now supports Alpine 3.17 - 3.19, Debian 12 and Ubuntu 24.04.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] The linux installation script now supports RHEL 8 and 9 based operating systems. (Thanks to @Oreloth)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Christmas skins weren't displayed when the holiday was active - also updated the Holiday.eco template to cover the christmas holiday dates for the next few years.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 11.1 released! Explosives, Land Vehicle Painting and Repair Bounties!
notes.content:
Hello Eco Citizens,
we're happy to announce the immediate availability of Update 11.1, let's take a look at what's new:

[h2]Explosives[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/9b94e508161161b44db4a237396fb722e977974a.jpg[/img]
Dynamite and Mining Charges controllable by Remote Detonators can now be crafted, allowing you to mine comfortably before heavy machinery becomes available. For this we have - next to Peat, which is also new - added Sulfur to the world generation and introduced the new materials Black Powder, Blasting Cap and Nitric Acid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/91265f5e319f65c9970ad485b9ec4e245ec8874c.jpg[/img]
Explosives convert rock and ores into their crushed form, making it easy to mine them with the scoop attachment for the Steam Tractor. Be cautious, though, explosives affect flora and fauna, move the ground, make blocks fall and can even destroy player-built structures - of course they respect authorization and civic restrictions. Boom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/e0b1a0da57bca0c76dfe51a1aa83e0f5a84ff953.gif[/img]

[h2]Painting for land vehicles[/h2]
We have added the ability to paint almost all land vehicles in multiple zones, allowing you to use your creativity and having your own, unique vehicle. We also added painting capability to the Blacksmith Table, Power Hammer, Storage Chest and Wall Mounted Chest as a preview for object painting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/8e9257203ef8dc6f301b968a9f6884c22bb6f8e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/834143ba9bdc8d14aceb4ea1361ad6a60567dd65.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/7d23791466d96f3186f5e5b589a9198c08eb9db2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/40102f9fce782010c7112d90e0ac25be32949103.jpg[/img]
[h2]Reworked Powered Cart[/h2]
The first vehicle we introduced to Eco got a full rework and highly improved steering capabilities, look at that beauty and try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/7d19f6a8da89d92460465ee5eee2ca3e4eb0ea87.jpg[/img]
[h2]Extended Maintenance and Repair Bounties[/h2]
Maintenance using parts now also applies to generators and vehicles. We also added a new repair bounty system, allowing other players to repair your machinery while you are offline in exchange for payment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/2bce2278eedb3429eab2c5486b9c4575bf596186.jpg[/img]
[h2]Reworked Tutorial[/h2]
We have reworked and majorly expanded the tutorial to explain more mechanics and guide players through towards their first base, fixing many issues the system had.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/711066d45f64a94096097d6445a9647cc4ea14e2.jpg[/img][h2]Log Furniture[/h2]
A new set of furniture made of logs is available in the early game, consisting of the Stump Bed, Stump Chair, Stump Latrine and Stump Table. Additionally we added a wooden sliding door and made the new Shoji Door available in the marketplace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/93419d8eaaaa472deb059146938fb5d03bbb7617.jpg[/img]

[h2]Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[b][u]Recipes[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]Added:[/b] A new charcoal recipe requiring Peat.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Phosphate Fertilizer now requires less Crushed Limestone, but additional Crushed Sulfur.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Synthetic Rubber and Rubber Wheels now require Crushed Sulfur.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Gasoline, Nylon and Plastic now output Sulfur as a byproduct.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Gearbox and Combustion Generator now requires Lubricant.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Waterwheel now requires Wooden Hull Planks.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Wind Turbine now requires Lubricant and Steel Plates instead of bars.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] The yield of Garden Gravel and Zen Gardens per craft was reduced to 2.
[/list]
[b][u]Housing & Rooms[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]Changed:[/b] The housing value of Adorned Ashlar Chairs was reduced to 1.7 from 2.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] The housing value of Adorned Ashlar Tables was reduced to 3 from 3.5.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Buntings, Streamers, Paper Lanterns and Limestone Statues are no longer required to be inside of a room.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] The Paint Mixer now requires a Tier 1.8 room.[/list]
[b][u]Other Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] All power generators now have maintenance parts that need to be replaced over time.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] All vehicles but the Small Canoe, Egyptian Canoe, Small Wood Cart and Wheelbarrow now have maintenance parts that need to be replaced over time.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] All parts used for maintenance can now be repaired by different materials.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] The energy output of all generators has been increased significantly.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Wooden Barge and Industrial Barge now have internal storage. 
[*][b]Changed:[/b] By default, the oil layer is no longer displayed until Oil Drilling was discovered.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] The Electronic Machinist Table now takes a Mining Modern Upgrade.
[*][b]Changed:[/b] Flax plants now use more fertilizers.
[/list]
[h3]Civics[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] An action for laws to trigger on ringing the town bell.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] An action for laws to trigger on the sale of cultural objects.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] Steam Tractor is now selectable for civics in the "Dig or Mine" trigger.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] An option at the immigration desk to set the settlement foundation as spawn point instead of the immigration desk. (Thanks to @silibum)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Compost, Garbage and Tailings were wrongly listed in the "Drop or pickup" trigger instead of the "Dig or Mine" trigger, making it impossible to regulate these activities as they need to be shovelled.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Contracts could sometimes display the "Add clause" button for players that aren't the creator of the contract.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Removed deeds weren't correctly deleted, leading to multiple issues.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The notification about a deed no longer attached to settlement influence didn't note which deed it was about.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The immigration desk setting to become a citizen of the settlement on placement of a homestead was only available if the settlement also allowed players to instantly join directly through the spawn menu. (Thanks to @MonzUn)
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Trying to mark a contract as failed despite completed led to an error message kicking the player from the server.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Setting rent cost as value for rent led to a server crash.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Annexation considered all claim papers equal, no matter if it was the required type, leading to issues when trying to conduct an annexation.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Renaming the default mayor title of a settlement created a new treasury, leading to potential further issues.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Deleting a title from the registrar with a setup backup title caused all deeds owned by it to become unowned instead of being transferred to the backup title.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Elected Titles could have themselves set as backup title.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Custom stats couldn't be requested correctly in specific circumstances.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A send notice action after a prevent action was not executed.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Orphaned civics will now be attached as draft instead of active, being forced active when the constitution is ratified or the settlement is founded to prevent issues to occur that could lead to a reset to the default constitution.[/list]
[h3]Interaction[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Crafting tables continued to run and burn fuel for a while despite not crafting something.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Dismounting from the crane was not possible.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Barges could be picked up even when they were loaded or had vehicles on it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Rotate hints for blocks were shown even if the block isn't rotatable.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Using the consolidate button removed skill scrolls and claim papers.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Placing a stockpile in a room could lead to it being classified as "outdoor", disabling tables that are required to be indoors.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In some circumstances tables with an active work party on them didn't enable participating players to add labour.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Tables with active work parties on them did show a wrong authorization outline to participating players.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Objects that couldn't be painted showed the paint interaction.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Paint mixer didn't see the contents of linked storages when mixing paints.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could lead to items in inventories going invisible until moved around.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could lead to the work order area in crafting tables not being displayed until a client restart.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Dragging and dropping storages in the storage tab of world objects was only possible on the name of the storage instead of the whole line.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could lead to icons on signs not being displayed and text to be incorrectly truncated.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Vote counts for yes were cut off in the popup showing all votes for an election.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Notifications would sometimes not correctly display when containing clickable buttons.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The tutorial boxes weren't limited in width.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Holding a food item could lead to objects the player isn't authorized on to still show a green outline.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] In specific circumstances the filter checkboxes for the item filter could appear in a duplicated way.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Sorting by distance for crafting tables in the economy viewer didn't always provide the expected result.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Several typos throughout the game.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Error message when steam is offline has been updated.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Recipe search in the crafting ui now has a clear button to remove the entered text.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Recipes in the crafting ui will now indicate they have variations before clicking on them.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] A confusing description of server settings in the Server UI when exhaustion is enabled.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Moved position of the abandon specialty button to the level line, making the feature more obvious.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Searching in the economy viewer now also allows filtering for name of an item and tags.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Abandoned players are now excluded from the display in the skills menu. (Canny Suggestion)
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] The town bell no longer rings indefinitely, but only when using the respective interaction.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The exhaustion tutorial was displayed and not completable when exhaustion is disabled.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Sometimes vehicles could load before the barges they were placed on, causing them to fall through them into the water.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The picture printer tab on the printing press didn't show a preview of the image.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Filtering for exhaustion in the server browser didn't work correctly.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Internal fuel storage was counted as general storage for crafting projects.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Scrap tool recipe did incorrectly take into account tools in the player inventory.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that sometimes caused Eco to fail to start when Steam is in offline mode.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Setting the meteor impact to high numbers in the world settings ui could cause the server to no longer start due to an invalid value being set in the config.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Twitch linking didn't work correctly.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When logging out to log in to another account and providing wrong credentials, the game automatically logged the player in with the account they logged out of before.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] When reflections were enabled in the graphics settings, the change didn't immediately apply.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] A meteor successfully shot down would reappear after a server restart, resetting the received achievement on the world as well.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Spawning at a immigration desk could place the player behind instead of in front of the desk.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Metal parts on objects were displayed in a darker color when painted.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue with rooms that could cause a server crash.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] All window planters now take seeds and function like the other planting pots.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Some changes for improved moddability of config and food systems. (Thanks to @Spouke and @MonzUn)
[/list]
[h3]Server & Configs[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] An option to remove only oneself from a title in the tooltip when the admin ui is enabled.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Skill Cost Multiplier for High Collaboration was wrongly set to 1.5 instead of 2, leading to servers using the default settings to not be marked as High Collaboration in the server list
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Using the command /meteor destroy would set "MeteorImpactDays" to -1, which as an invalid value prevented the server from starting.
[/list]
[u][b]Balance.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "ShowOilLayer" config variable, determining if the oil layer is shown despite the Oil Drilling skill not having been discovered - defaults to false.
[/list]
[u][b]Difficulty.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "RequireSkillsToReplaceParts" config variable, determining if the respective skill is required to replace a part - defaults to true on high collaboration, otherwise to false.
[*] [b]Added:[/b] "BrokenPartsWillDisableVehicles" config variable, determining if a vehicle becomes unusable when it has broken parts or just becomes slower - defaults to true on medium or higher collaboration, otherwise to false.[/list]
[u][b]StrangeWorlds.template.eco[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] "ShowPurchaseNotification" config variable, determining if purchases in the marketplace are shown in the notifications area - defaults to true.[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] Migration from the prior version is supported, but the new "Peat" and "Sulfur" will not be added to existing worlds and require a new world to appear. Sulfur can also be received through some crafting recipes.

Thank you for your support and enjoy the new update!

- Strange Loop

notes.title: Eco 11 is released! Adobe, Painting, Outdoor Rooms, Maintenance and Marketplace!
notes.content:
Hello Citizens,
Today we are launching Eco 11!  Features include:
[olist][*] [b]Expanded Culture[/b] – Deeds can now be rated just like pictures, providing culture for cultural deeds and housing xp bonuses for residential deeds.
[*] [b]Painting[/b] – You can now create paint from dye and paint building blocks in a large variety of colors.
[*] [b]Outdoor Rooms[/b] – You can now decorate your deed's outdoor areas and gain additional housing experience, as long as you don't use industrial machinery on them!
[*] [b]Maintenance[/b] – Most crafting tables now require a constant supply of maintenance materials to run, ensuring a steady demand of resources.
[*] [b]Repairs[/b] – Items can now be repaired with multiple different objects and only have a limited amount of repairs until they break for good.
[*] [b]Marketplace[/b] – Eco Marketplace is now here, allowing players to support the development by purchasing cosmetics. Proceeds are being shared with the community, starting with server owners for now.
[*] [b]Adobe Blockset[/b] – Adobe is the new Tier 1 blockset for Eco, with all others having moved up a tier. Adobe was specifically designed to allow you to quickly get up your first home. 
[*] [b]Offline Play[/b] – Eco can now be played on local servers without internet connection!
[/olist]
And now, let's go into the details:

[h2]Culture for Property[/h2]
Creating amazing buildings has always been a big part of Eco, and with this update we’ve made it tie into gameplay directly by [b]allowing architecture to generate culture and housing points[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/f8c8667dcd570b95f043933696fd54281a0f0629.jpg[/img]
By placing down a plaque, other citizens can give reputation to your construction. If it’s on a cultural property, that will translate directly into additional culture. However, if it’s on residential property, that will translate into [i]additional housing points[/i] with a multiplier, meaning the skill rate you get for housing can be significantly increased when you create a beautiful construction that gets appreciated by your fellow citizens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/2efbe62fc95e3153a553a900a414ea1342cb5e9e.jpg[/img]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/fcfd561cfa23ac69ab7521d571585fcd2382598c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Painting[/h2]
Following directly from that, we’ve added the ability to paint blocks and later this will also extend to objects (vehicles and tables) to really customize your towns and make them your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/01de496b4f71ed8c9076adf5ffc010bd53f87e04.jpg[/img]
Towns can now look really unique and different from each other, giving a lot of variety in the visuals of the game. 

Paint is created by collecting dyes and mixing them together at the new Mixing Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/e14928be07fc27fcc992fdc3a7964d893dfd5579.jpg[/img]
Paints can then be used with one of the new paint sprayers, applying varying levels of coating to blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/a6a9e16c136778146773cebf2637c6627221fe68.png[/img]
Dyes require different ingredients, some of which are more rare than others, so there will be a variety in values of paint. Since paint is an item that can be sold in stores as well, you’ll start to see people setting up paint stores offering a variety of colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/cbf86f882c08c6ee43c60b0605e858455d79e3c3.jpg[/img]
In a near-future update we'll add the ability to paint world objects too (vehicles, crafting stations, etc).

[h2]Outdoor Rooms[/h2]
In the same vein of making your spaces beautiful for game benefits, we’re introducing Outdoor Rooms.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/c4eda5b8a0c8f847940d128907209248ff250e8c.jpg[/img]
Now the outdoor section of a property will be treated as its own ‘room’ for purposes of housing points, and a number of new outdoor housing object have been added to support it. It supports the above architecture bonus as well: beautiful outdoor spaces now have a game incentive through architecture and housing bonuses.

Together, these three changes culture points for architecture, painting, and outdoor rooms takes a step towards aligning game success with creative endeavors.  Eco's design principle is creating systems that interact with each other, and the game emerges from their complex interactions; this addition follows that by connecting the creation of a beautiful space to the skill system, through housing points.

[h2]Maintenance[/h2]
One issue that we wanted to address was the number of specialties that are really important for creating a specific object, but once that object is created there’s not much more use for them.  With the addition of maintenance, parts will need to repaired and replaced within tables, using the same specialties that created the original object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/91fdea3a929ce8fdfce3db23a141fef042e7d702.jpg[/img]
When these parts break down, the object will cease to function, and you’ll need to get them repaired or replaced. which leads to our next upgrade:

[h2]Repairs[/h2]
Now you can use multiple different repair materials to repair an object, and each one will reduce the max durability in varying rates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/e2b2d31fa7cd9d5617f52cb288f8763d0ef8915f.png[/img]
Some repair materials may be more expensive, but make your tools and parts last longer, so it will be a tradeoff to consider.  Eventually, after many repairs, the durability of objects will drop so low that they have to be replaced, creating further demand in the economy. 

The skills of the citizen doing the repair will also impact the change in durability and how much material is needed, so a repair market will be incentivized as specialized craftsmen can repair their fellow citizen’s tools and parts. 

We'll also be connecting this to the economy and government in an update shortly after 11, so that a repair person can find and repair other people's tables for money, paid either by the table owner or the government. This will make a new type of 'quest' that requires unique skills and materials and will appear in the economy viewer (and is also disableable if people prefer a world without maintenance). 

[h2]Eco Marketplace[/h2]
As you’ve probably noticed, many survival crafting games these days have microtransactions, which shifts the financial incentive from purely selling new copies to also supporting your long-term players.  As we start approaching the end of Eco’s Early Access, we wanted to find a way to introduce them that suits Eco and will be a value-add for players. Specifically, the goal is to 
[list]
[*]Avoid giving direct gameplay advantage (they are cosmetic only and can’t be traded or used by others by default).
[*]Not allow access to mechanically-different items (all cosmetic items are skins of regular items).
[*]Support the Eco community (proceeds shared with server hosts and eventually others).
[*]Support the ethos of Eco (shared with charity).
[*]Be fully optional (hosted servers can disable them entirely).
[/list]
In the new Eco Marketplace, you can buy Eco Credits through Steam, which you can then spend on Blueprints which let you craft differently-skinned versions of items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/1ba6703997d21b8eae4a38d41a8231209de2ff6d.jpg[/img]
A Blueprint will allow you to build one copy of an item, and many blueprints are sold in packs.  The premium variants appear in the crafting UI as variants under the main product and will be functionally identical to the base item.  When you buy a Blueprint, you can use it in [i]all[/i] servers indefinitely (unless restricted by host admins), and the count resets each server cycle within an individual server.

Because so much of Eco’s value comes from the community, we wanted to find a way to share that value with them in an interesting way. To do that, we’ve implemented percentage-share from every Eco Credit transaction that goes to the value creators in the Eco ecosystem.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/55f69c64922430ba4e6592c4ba2c5dce8c76e108.jpg[/img]
To start with, server hosts will get a percentage of all credits that are spent in their world, and we will provide a way to pay for hosting services with Eco Credits, thus allowing an active community to fund its own world through the transactions in the world.

In the vein of supporting all the value-contributors in the Eco universe, we wanted to include  Earth and the real Ecosystem itself, through a percent of all transactions going to the charity The Ocean Cleanup.  This charity is doing a phenomenal job using advanced technology to clean up plastics from the ocean on a massive scale, and thus fits the theme of Eco very well.  So with every transaction in Eco Credits you’ll be supporting both Eco, the server host of your world, and the Earth itself.

[previewyoutube=Pv1Otdg4fok;full][/previewyoutube]
Later, we plan to include other sources that provide value to the Eco universe,  including approved modders that will earn a percent of all transactions in a world, as well as streamers that promote worlds earning a cut of proceeds in those worlds. Long term, we plan to allow approved server hosts creating amazing experiences to withdraw Eco Credits..

Eco’s had a long, long incubation period in Early Access and has an amazing, dedicated community of players and creators, and we’re very aware that introducing microtransactions can cause a lot of disruption, but hopefully players will see this as a good thing for the game long-term, giving us another way to fund it with a source different than only new-players, and introducing new support to the community surrounding Eco as well. On top of that, for those players categorically against microtransactions (which we respect), [i]we’ve allowed servers to disable it entirely[/i] and they can play without it, which will be displayed in the server browser.

[h2]Adobe Blockset and Balance Changes[/h2]
One of our goals for v1 Eco is to make a much smoother entry experience for new users, and we’re taking a step in that direction with the creation of a new building tier, Adobe Blocks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/3b2f157a10cde725e050063a193fe531b7787312.jpg[/img]
Adobe blocks will be easier and faster to construct than hewn logs, making them an easy and fast way for new players to get setup in the world with a home, as they learn the other mechanics of the game.  We’ve rearranged the starting table requirements so that some will function in this new Tier-0 style building.

[h2]Offline Play[/h2]
There have been some cases where our account servers went down and prevented play, which understandably upset a lot of players who wanted to be able to play without DRM.  Good news for them, [b]Eco can now be played offline[/b], meaning even if our auth servers go down, or if you don’t have internet access at all, you will still be able to play.

[h2]And More[/h2]
Along with these major updates we’ve added a large number of minor improvements, performance optimizations (we’ve fixed the slowdown that happens after a few hours of play!), an account system full-upgrade, and much more. We’re hot on the path of Eco v1, check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/382310/announcements/detail/4174344193742545600]Roadmap to Eco 1.0 blog post[/url] detailing what we have in store. And as always thanks for the great support from our Eco citizens, much more to come. 

[h2]Streamer Event[/h2]
In celebration of the launch, we're hosting a Streamer event that makes use of the unique features of Eco: 🛠️[b]Socialism vs Capitalism[/b]💰!  We'll have a few worlds for different languages running on a two week cycle where citizens will be separated into separate camps, socialist and capitalist, and will build societies that embody those values. Eventually, they'll have to cooperate to destroy the meteor and save the planet. Will make for a really interesting social experiment as well, so check that out on streaming this week. We'll also have some themed twitch drops for viewers,[url=https://play.eco/twitch] follow the event on our website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/1e626a1a2f3bbf998fd74c383572768d88a12a2a.jpg[/img]

[b]Important Info for the Update:[/b]
- Update 11 introduces new backend services that are deployed in multiple stages. While we do our best so you don't notice anything about that, please bear with us in case of problems and reach out to support@strangeloopgames.com if you notice any account issues.
- Some features are temporarily not available during the deployment phase: Buying tiers & invites on our website, sending invites via the website as well as tier benefits (cosmetics and icons) and twitch drops.
- Servers in Update 11 need to login to an SLG account, that can be either done directly in the window the server executable will prompt you with or with the commandline parameters --username="<USERNAME"> and --password="<PASSWORD>".

Big thanks to our community for all the support of the years as we march towards v1 and exiting Early Access!

notes.title: Update 11 is launching on August 15th!
notes.content:
Hello Eco Citizens,
our next release date has been set: [b]Eco 11 will launch August 15th![/b]

We’ve been hard at work on the road to Eco 1.0 and exiting Early Access, and this is a big step there. Feature list will be:

[h2]Adobe Blockset[/h2]
A new tier-1 blockset (pushing Hewn Logs/Mortared Stone to tier 2) that’s much easier to build, giving a faster start to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/3b2f157a10cde725e050063a193fe531b7787312.jpg[/img]
[h2]Painting[/h2]
You can now mix paints and paint your constructions with a variety of tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/a6a9e16c136778146773cebf2637c6627221fe68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/e9b2883300f007b7ba7cb023973a4c47350f5b23.jpg[/img]
[h2]Culture for Architecture[/h2]
We’ve added a new source for culture: Architecture! Creative and beautiful buildings can now earn culture and will give housing benefits on residential property.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/f8c8667dcd570b95f043933696fd54281a0f0629.jpg[/img]
[h2]Outdoor "Rooms"[/h2]
Outdoor areas will now generate housing points, and we’ve added a number of outdoor items to make decorating your spaces beautifully have an impact on gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/c4eda5b8a0c8f847940d128907209248ff250e8c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Maintenance and Repair[/h2]
We've added a new maintenance system which will roll out over several updates, the first part is Tools and Crafting Stations where tools permanently degrade when repaired and crafting stations require replaceable components.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/91fdea3a929ce8fdfce3db23a141fef042e7d702.jpg[/img]
[h2]Eco Marketplace[/h2]
We’re introducing a way to buy cosmetic variants of existing items as a way to support Eco’s development and show your support in the game.  These are totally optional and will be cosmetic only, and will make it financially feasible to continue growing the game for our most dedicated long-term players. More details to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25097638/1ba6703997d21b8eae4a38d41a8231209de2ff6d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Offline Play [/h2]
Eco can now run without any connection to the internet, no longer requiring a connection to our servers or the internet at all for playing on local servers.

[b]Lots more bugfixes and optimizations[/b] as always. 

We’ll be sharing full notes in streams and at launch but wanted to share a bit of what we have in store to the community. As always thanks for your awesome support as we build towards V1!

notes.title: Maintenance Update 10.2.2 released!
notes.content:
Hey Citizens,
we have just released Maintenance Update 10.2.2 to address the following issues:

[h3]General:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An exploit that allowed to convert any block material to any other block material when building.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Multiple causes for memory leaks on servers in relation to room calculations - thanks to all server admins that provided us with valuable data.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could cause players to have a duplicated avatar.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Added missing "MaxDimensionOfUserTexture" config variable to UserTextures.eco.template.[/list]
[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved:[/b] Increased experience gain from crafting Nails, Iron, Steel, Modern Tools and Handheld Camera.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Increased the amount of Ceramic Molds returned when crafting Steel Bars from 2 to 3.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Increased the storage radius of the Wooden Transport Ship.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Increased the storage radius of the Store.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Level requirements for shipwright vehicles and dependencies are now in a more logical order.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Large Cotton Bunting Festive now requires boards to craft, as intended.[/list]
[h3]Civics:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Unrestricted claim papers from the respective server setting or spawned by an admin were considered as homestead papers when trying to join a settlement with such papers in use, preventing to join.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Usage of unrestricted claim papers with settlements could cause a variety of crashes when the game tried to move them elsewhere due to for example a law action unclaiming or transferring a property.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Usage of unrestricted claim papers could lead to settlement foundations vanishing and the settlement "merging" with a player's homestead.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] An issue that could crash the server and subsequently prevent the world from loading related to property transfers occuring through laws.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] The executive actions for seizing bank accounts and giving reputation weren't respecting jurisdiction.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Injunctions didn't correctly block selected laws.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Bank accounts couldn't be deleted.[/list]
[h3]Exhaustion:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Changed:[/b] "BonusRetroactiveHoursAfterStart" and "MaxSavedHours" config options now only take effect when "AllowPlaytimeSaving" is enabled. "BonusHoursOnExhaustionEnabled" will always work, but no longer roll over to the next day when the first login happened shortly before the exhaustion reset. This was changed due to feedback from server admins that the settings were confusing and will be revisited later.
[*] [b]Improved:[/b] Not applicable settings no longer show in the server info in the server browser.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Setting "BonusHoursOnExhaustionEnabled" or "MaxSavedHours" config variables to 0 would prevent players that had not connected to the server before that to join it.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Multiple issues with incorrect resets for exhaustion when the reset time wasn't equal to the change of day in local server time.[/list]
[h3]Pictures:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Added:[/b] Reimplemented the ability to disallow uploads in the Printing Press based on feedback from server admins. The formerly deprecated config variable "AllowTextureUpload" in UserTextures.eco.template can be used to control that, but will be renamed in a later update to reflect the changed scope of the setting.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Images that weren't approved could be put into frames.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Images in frames were visible to players despite not being approved.
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] Automatic approval of pictures didn't work with the setting noted in UserTextures.eco.template.[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
